*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:#F2F1EE;color:#1E1C1A;font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Yu Gothic','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:#1E1C1A}
a:hover{color:#7A5C36}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #A9875B;outline-offset:3px}
summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details[open] .dc-plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){*{transition:none !important;animation:none !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important}}


/* v4 finishing: reception image, section order, prices and reviews stay intact. */
.finish-site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,28,26,.05)}
html{scroll-padding-top:88px}
.hero-sentence{display:block}
.hero-sentence+.hero-sentence{margin-top:10px}
.hero-sentence strong{white-space:nowrap}
.method-lead{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.025em;margin-bottom:10px}
.method-body{display:block;max-width:29em}
.finish-method figcaption{box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(30,28,26,.07)}
.finish-trial .trial-prep>p:first-child{padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #D8CDBD;color:#36322E!important}
.finish-trial .trial-prep>p:nth-of-type(2){padding-top:6px}
.finish-trial [role="tab"]{transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease}
.finish-trial .trial-facts>div{align-items:flex-start}
.finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div:last-child{padding-left:24px;border-left:1px solid #DDD6CB}
.finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div[aria-hidden]{display:none!important}
.finish-method .method-diagram{background:#FAF8F4;padding:26px 28px 24px!important;border-top:2px solid #A9875B!important}
.finish-method .method-diagram>p:first-child{margin-bottom:14px!important}
.finish-method .method-diagram svg{max-height:230px}
@media(max-width:959px){
 #top a[data-placement="home_hero"],#top a[data-placement="home_hero_line"]{max-width:none!important;flex-basis:100%!important}
 .finish-method figcaption{box-shadow:none}
 .finish-method .method-lead{font-size:16px}
 .finish-trial .trial-panel>div:first-child{padding:26px 22px!important}
 .finish-trial .trial-prep{padding:24px 22px!important}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.06fr 1fr;gap:12px!important;width:100%;align-items:start}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div{min-width:0}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div:last-child{padding-left:14px}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div>span:first-child{font-size:12px!important;white-space:nowrap}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div>span:last-child{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px!important}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div>span:last-child>span{font-size:16px!important}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div>span:last-child>span[style*="font-family"]{font-size:40px!important;letter-spacing:-.02em}
 .finish-trial .trial-facts>div>div>span:last-child>span:last-child[style*="14px"]{font-size:12px!important;flex-basis:100%}
 .finish-trial>div>div:last-child>div{width:100%}
 .finish-trial a[data-placement="home_trial"],.finish-trial a[data-placement="home_trial_guide"]{width:100%;justify-content:center}
 .finish-method .method-diagram{padding:22px 0 0!important;background:transparent;border-top:1px solid #C9BFB0!important}
 .finish-method .method-diagram>p:first-child{font-size:13px!important;letter-spacing:0!important}
 .hero-break{display:none}
}



/* v4.2: spacing within groups. Content, order, imagery and header stay. */
#top .hero-sentence+.hero-sentence{margin-top:16px}
#top .finish-hero-title+p{margin-top:30px!important}
#top .finish-hero-title+p+div{margin-top:38px!important}
#method .method-lead{margin-bottom:16px}
#method .method-person{gap:24px!important}
#method .method-diagram{margin-top:64px!important;padding:34px 32px 32px!important}
#method .method-diagram>p:first-child{margin-bottom:20px!important}
#method .method-diagram .method-input{padding:18px 0!important}
#method .method-diagram .method-result{padding:32px!important;gap:14px!important}
#trial .trial-facts{margin-top:48px!important;gap:28px 64px!important;padding-bottom:40px!important;align-items:flex-start!important}
#trial .trial-facts>ul{gap:12px!important}
#trial .trial-facts+p{margin-top:48px!important;margin-bottom:20px!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child{padding:48px!important}
#trial .trial-panel h3+p{margin-top:28px!important;margin-bottom:20px!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol{gap:32px 32px!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol>li{padding-top:20px!important;gap:14px!important}
#trial .trial-panel ol ol{gap:14px!important}
#trial .trial-prep{padding:40px 36px!important;gap:18px!important}
#trial .trial-prep>ul{gap:12px!important}
#trial .trial-prep>p:nth-of-type(2){padding-top:12px!important}
#trial>div>div:last-child{margin-top:56px!important;gap:24px 28px!important}
#voice-rail article{padding-top:40px!important;padding-bottom:40px!important;gap:20px!important}
#voice-rail article>div{gap:18px!important}
@media(max-width:959px){
 #top .finish-hero-title+p{margin-top:24px!important}
 #top .finish-hero-title+p+div{margin-top:32px!important}
 #method .method-person{gap:22px!important}
 #method .method-diagram{margin-top:48px!important;padding:28px 0 0!important}
 #method .method-diagram .method-input{padding:0 0 22px 24px!important}
 #method .method-diagram .method-result{padding:28px!important;gap:14px!important}
 #trial .trial-facts{margin-top:36px!important;gap:28px!important;padding-bottom:32px!important}
 #trial .trial-facts>ul{gap:14px!important}
 #trial .trial-facts+p{margin-top:40px!important;margin-bottom:18px!important}
 #trial .trial-panel>div:first-child{padding:34px 22px 36px!important}
 #trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol{row-gap:32px!important}
 #trial .trial-prep{padding:32px 22px!important}
 #trial>div>div:last-child{margin-top:42px!important;gap:24px!important}
 #voice-rail article{padding-top:30px!important;padding-bottom:30px!important}
}



/* v4.3 scoped details. Hero and pricing are unchanged. */
#method{padding-block:clamp(72px,8cqw,112px)!important}
#trial,#voice{padding-block:clamp(88px,8.6cqw,132px)!important}
#trial{padding-block:clamp(96px,9cqw,144px)!important}
.trial-intro-sentence{display:block}
.trial-intro-sentence+.trial-intro-sentence{margin-top:12px}
#trial .trial-panel h3{display:block!important}
#trial .trial-panel h3>span:first-child{display:block;font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-weight:600!important;font-size:28px!important;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.035em!important}
#trial .trial-panel h3>span:last-child{display:block;margin-top:12px;line-height:1.9;letter-spacing:.025em}
#trial [role=tablist]{margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom-color:#C8BDAE!important}
#trial [role=tab]{border:0!important;background:transparent!important;margin:0!important;min-height:76px!important;padding:16px 12px!important;gap:8px 12px!important}
#trial [role=tab]::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:24px;right:24px;height:2px;background:transparent}
#trial [role=tab][aria-selected=true]::after{background:#7A5C36}
#trial [role=tab]:hover{background:#F3EFE8!important}
#trial [role=tablist]+div{border-left:0!important;border-right:0!important;border-top:1px solid #DDD6CB!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child{padding:58px 48px!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol>li>span{font-weight:500!important;line-height:1.8}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol>li{gap:18px!important;padding-top:24px!important}
#trial .trial-panel>div:first-child>ol{column-gap:36px!important;row-gap:40px!important}
#trial .trial-prep{padding-block:56px!important}
#voice-rail h3{font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-size:23px!important;font-weight:600!important;line-height:1.7!important;letter-spacing:.025em}
.voice-title-chunk{display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
#voice .voice-arrow{width:48px!important;height:48px!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;transition:color .15s ease,background .15s ease}
#voice .voice-arrow:not(:disabled):hover{color:#7A5C36!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)!important}
@media(max-width:959px){
 #voice-rail h3{font-size:21px!important}
 #trial .trial-panel h3>span:first-child{font-size:24px!important}
 #trial .trial-panel>div:first-child{padding:46px 22px!important}
 #trial .trial-prep{padding-block:46px!important}
 #trial [role=tab]{padding:14px 4px!important;min-height:80px!important}
 #trial [role=tab]::after{left:12px;right:12px}
 .trial-intro-sentence+.trial-intro-sentence{margin-top:14px}
}

</style>
